title: Local algebraic reduction diagrams over the constant ring
statement: Let $X$ be Noetherian, $g:Y\to X$ an immersion, $d$ an adic coefficient datum on $A$, and $M$ a normalized adic tower [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum, def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. Assume each level is cohomologically bounded, with bounds depending on the level, and its relatively restricted finite-coefficient cohomology is finite lisse. Set $C=\widehat A$ and $J=IC$. There is a covering sieve on the final pro-etale object of $Y$ such that on each member $U$ there are $K_n\in D(C/J^{n+1})$ with finite cohomology and universal consecutive scalar-normalization arrows $t_n$. Every cohomological vanishing of $M_n$ holds for $K_n$. Form the $C$-linear strict tower $s$ from $t$ by the canonical derived restriction composition maps. For any $E\in D(C)$, any left adjoints $L_n$ to scalar restriction from $C/J^{n+1}$, and isomorphisms $e_{0,n}:L_nE\cong K_n$ whose actual adjunction units commute with $s$, the finite reductions of $a_{U\to X}E$ along $r_n$ of [def-weil-pbc-constant-adic-finite-diagram-data] have finite-lisse cohomology and quotient-linear isomorphisms to the restricted $M_n$. These satisfy the forward square with pbcReductionTransition along $r_m,q_{mn},r_n$ for every $n\le m$. No completed ring sheaf, completed realization, scalar maps phi or beta, or choice of algebraic E is asserted.

proof.text: Apply lisse_tower_constant_stalk_models to obtain the covering sieve, finite algebraic stalk tower, quotient-linear constant isomorphisms b_n, finite lissity of restricted M, and compatibility after restriction to the common constant completion ring.

For any supplied E, L_n and adjunctions, take the invertible scalar mate of the canonical right comparison, compose with F_n(e0_n) and b_n, and call the result e_n. Naturality of the right comparison and the adjunction Hom bijection show that the adjunct of e_n is a_g(unit_n followed by restriction of e0_n) followed by z_n. Map the assumed unit compatibility through a_g and substitute the local z compatibility. This gives equality of the two adjuncts of the required quotient-linear square, after the canonical restriction composition isomorphism. Cancel that isomorphism and use injectivity of the adjunction Hom bijection to obtain the square for every n<=m, including equality. Exact homology and scalar restriction transport finite lissity along e_n.

theorem lisse_tower_constant_algebraic_reduction_diagram
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (g : Y ⟶ X) [IsImmersion g]
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (M : AdicTower X d)
    (hbounded : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, (q < a ∨ b < q) →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj (M.level n)))
    (hlisse : ∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
      IsRelativelyFiniteLisseModule g (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))
        ((pbcRestrict ((adicTowerInverseImage g).map
          (pbcLevelConstantComparison X d n).hom)).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
              ((adicTowerPullback g ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj (M.level n))))) :
    let C := AdicCompletion d.ideal A
    let J := d.ideal.map (algebraMap A C)
    ∃ V : Sieve (⊤_ Y.ProEt), V ∈ ProEt.topology Y (⊤_ Y.ProEt) ∧
      ∀ (U : Y.ProEt) (f : U ⟶ ⊤_ Y.ProEt), V f →
        ∃ (K : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (C ⧸ J ^ (n + 1))))
          (t : ∀ n : ℕ, K (n + 1) ⟶
            (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (Ideal.Quotient.factor
              (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := J) (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))).mapDerivedCategory.obj
                  (K n)),
          (∀ (n : ℕ) (N : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (C ⧸ J ^ (n + 1)))),
            Function.Bijective (fun k : K n ⟶ N ↦ t n ≫
              (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (Ideal.Quotient.factor
                (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := J) (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))).mapDerivedCategory.map
                    k)) ∧
          (∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
            IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj (M.level n)) →
            IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (C ⧸ J ^ (n + 1))) q).obj (K n))) ∧
          (∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ), Module.Finite (C ⧸ J ^ (n + 1))
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (C ⧸ J ^ (n + 1))) q).obj (K n))) ∧
          let R (n : ℕ) := ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1}
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J ^ (n + 1)))
          let s (n : ℕ) := (R (n + 1)).mapDerivedCategory.map (t n) ≫
            (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso
              (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (Ideal.Quotient.factor
                (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := J) (Nat.le_succ (n + 1)))))
              (R (n + 1))).inv.app (K n) ≫
            (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso (ModuleCat.restrictScalarsComp'.{u + 1}
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J ^ (n + 2)))
              (Ideal.Quotient.factor
                (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := J) (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J ^ (n + 1)))
              (Ideal.Quotient.factor_comp_mk _).symm)).inv.app (K n)
          ∀ (E : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} C))
            (L : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} C) ⥤
              DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (C ⧸ J ^ (n + 1))))
            (adj : ∀ n : ℕ, L n ⊣ (R n).mapDerivedCategory)
            (e₀ : ∀ n : ℕ, (L n).obj E ≅ K n)
            (he₀ : ∀ (m n : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m),
              (adj m).unit.app E ≫ (R m).mapDerivedCategory.map (e₀ m).hom ≫
                (Functor.ofOpSequence
                  (X := fun k : ℕ ↦ (R k).mapDerivedCategory.obj (K k)) s).map
                  (homOfLE h).op =
              (adj n).unit.app E ≫ (R n).mapDerivedCategory.map (e₀ n).hom),
              (∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
                IsRelativelyFiniteLisseModule (U.hom ≫ g) (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))
                  ((pbcRestrict ((adicTowerInverseImage (U.hom ≫ g)).map
                    (pbcLevelConstantComparison X d n).hom)).obj
                      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
                        ((pbcDerivedExtend
                          (constantAdicFiniteProjection (U.hom ≫ g) d n)).obj
                            ((constantAdicFiniteRealization (U.hom ≫ g) d).obj E))))) ∧
              ∃ e : ∀ n : ℕ,
                (pbcDerivedExtend (constantAdicFiniteProjection (U.hom ≫ g) d n)).obj
                    ((constantAdicFiniteRealization (U.hom ≫ g) d).obj E) ≅
                  (adicTowerPullback (U.hom ≫ g) ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj
                    (M.level n),
                ∀ (m n : ℕ) (hnm : n ≤ m),
                  (e m).hom ≫ adicTowerRestrictedTransition d (U.hom ≫ g) M m n hnm =
                    pbcReductionTransition
                (constantAdicFiniteProjection (U.hom ≫ g) d m)
                ((adicTowerInverseImage (U.hom ≫ g)).map (pbcAdicQuotient X d m n hnm))
                (constantAdicFiniteProjection (U.hom ≫ g) d n)
                (constantAdicFiniteProjection_comp (U.hom ≫ g) d m n hnm)
                ((constantAdicFiniteRealization (U.hom ≫ g) d).obj E) ≫
                      (pbcDerivedRestrict ((adicTowerInverseImage (U.hom ≫ g)).map
                        (pbcAdicQuotient X d m n hnm))).map (e n).hom
